deferrals.reason: P5 remains shadow-only until a later explicitly certified release; no routing, blocking, or planner-output change is authorized.
P5 returns immutable in-memory artifacts and CausalReplay nodes; persistence, retention, redaction policy, and deletion controls require a separate governed design.
Programs unsupported by the current real-runtime lowerer remain rejected before P5; P5 does not create a second execution engine.
Only exact P2-declared or P2-inferred effects supported by the closed adapter inventory are simulated; inferred partial subsets and opaque provider semantics remain unsupported.
P5 accepts measured P3 distributions but does not collect, calibrate, persist, or promote likelihood data.
Unknown estimates stay unknown; audited empirical cost/latency feeds and drift monitoring are deferred.
Reservation, Authority, approvals, BusinessEffect creation, commit, observation, Work/Objective transitions, and reconciliation execution remain existing-runtime responsibilities.
Shadow comparison is observable only; making regressions block execution requires separate certification and rollback controls.
P5 branches are bounded immutable in-memory values, not database clones, durable workflows, or distributed jobs.
